name: IGRM
description: The Information Governance Reference Model. In this phase data is managed at the point of creation.  This phase is added here for completeness. For now there are now techniques added to this phase, but in the future they probably will.

name: Identification
description: Locating potential ESI (Electronically Stored Evidence), relevant to a case

name: Preservation
description: Implement legal holds to ensure that data is protected from deletion or alteration

name: Processing
description: Reducing data volumes, by filtering, de-duplication and format conversion for reviewing

name: Review
description: Examining data for relevance, privilege and confidentiality

name: Analysis
description: Evaluating data for content and patterns for more understanding the key facts and issues of a case

name: Production
description: Delivering relevant ESI to opposing parties in both agreed-upon formats

name: Presentation
description: Presenting evidence in hearings, depositions or trials
